prompt: On reviewer-owned disposable local infrastructure with synthetic data and no public or production target, design and execute an unfamiliar controlled resilience experiment and associated tabletop or game-day response. The reviewer secretly injects one target-scope expansion, one misleading steady-state or green-tool signal, one correlated abort or rollback dependency, one persistent correctness or security effect, and one organizational communication or authority failure. The learner must detect, contain and explain the conditions without accessing answer material.
deliverables: Named uncertainty, decision, critical flow, user, correctness and security promise, and explicit no-run conditions
Architecture, dependency, failure-domain, state-authority and experiment-control map
Versioned falsifiable hypothesis naming fault, target, mitigation, quantified tolerance and recovery deadline
Steady-state specification with populations, windows, thresholds, missing-data behavior and comparable control
Failure-mode rationale and exact pre-run resolved target inventory with immutable identities
Safety plan covering environment, synthetic data, blast radius, duration, concurrency, capacity, privilege and approvals
Independent observability, guardrail, abort, stop, rollback, recovery, reconciliation and exact cleanup design
Role and communication plan covering service owner, experiment lead, stop authority, incident command, recorder, dependency owners and support
Dry-run and preflight evidence proving baseline, control, target, authority, telemetry, capacity and recovery readiness
Timestamped execution journal proving actual intervention effect and continuous guard evaluation
Evidence detecting and handling all reviewer-injected scope, signal, control-path, correctness or security, and organizational defects
Unchanged hypothesis evaluation classified as supported, disproved or inconclusive with limitations
Rollback attempt plus separate correct-state, backlog, security, soak and cleanup evidence
Blameless review with prioritized findings, owners, acceptance tests, retest plan and regression decision
evidenceRequirements: All actions stay in reviewer-owned disposable local infrastructure using synthetic identities and data
No production system, public endpoint, external cloud resource, real credential, customer record, uncontrolled load or host-wide fault is used
The reviewer retains hidden defects, expected boundaries, stop authority, scoring and cleanup confirmation
The learner cannot alter hypothesis, thresholds, target policy or success criteria after observing the result
Intended selectors are insufficient; actual resolved targets and immutable identities are preserved
Tool acceptance or completion cannot substitute for independent evidence that the intervention applied
Infrastructure health cannot substitute for named user, correctness and security steady state
Control and treatment differences beyond the experiment variable remain visible as limitations
Abort observation and stop execution must not rely solely on the impaired path
Rollback execution cannot substitute for correct-state recovery and reconciliation
Any unexpected user, data or security impact converts the exercise to incident handling
Unknown artifacts, ambiguous authority, missing telemetry or unsafe cleanup cause refusal
Every result is bounded to the exact version, target, fault, workload, window and evidence coverage
Every finding has an owner, acceptance evidence and retest or explicit risk acceptance
Residual uncertainty and all evidence limitations remain visible

rubric.observableEvidence: Defines decision-changing uncertainty, promises, risk and no-run boundaries
Uses falsifiable mechanism and outcome statement with quantified tolerances
Builds comparable cohorts and preserves confounders and limitations
Selects realistic fault and binds exact targets, duration, concurrency and identity
Uses isolation, synthetic data, least privilege, approvals and independent stop
Rehearses continuous probes, abort, rollback, reconciliation, soak and cleanup
Preserves preflight, actual effect, timestamps, observations and injected-defect handling
Classifies supported, disproved or inconclusive without moving criteria or overclaiming
Exercises roles, communication, dependencies, support and incident conversion
Produces owned findings, acceptance tests, retest or regression and residual-risk record
